text:
Kevin: Heads-up, scheduling a staged toggle for feature flag `ff.low-latency-routing` tonight. Plan: 1% -> 5% after 10m -> 25% after 30m. Telemetry gates: p50 latency, p95 latency, error-rate, and model-fallback rate. Rollback on gates or manual stop.
Deploy-Bot: [automated] created rollout job r-3023456789, pinned variant `v3.2.1-canary`, commit abc1234, change-window: 22:00-23:00 UTC.
Olga: Copy — what's the concrete rollback criteria?
Kevin: Rollback if error-rate > 0.5% over 5m OR p95 latency > 3.5s OR model-fallbacks > 0.1% sustained for 3m. Also manual rollback allowed.
Jess: Can we pin traffic hitting Dedicated nodes to `v3.2.1`? We saw a model drift last week.
Kevin: Done, rollout job includes `variant=v3.2.1` and `--drain-on-fail`.
Maya: SRE Oncall here — I'll watch the dashboards and silence non-critical noise. @SRE-Oncall please ack.
SRE-Oncall: Acked. I'll keep critical alerts enabled. If gate trips I'll flip flag to 0% and notify.
Chris: I'll update release notes: "Staged enable of low-latency routing for up to 25% traffic; canary pinned to v3.2.1; telemetry gates in place."
Jess: Reminder: cache-warming step after 5%: `curl -X POST https://infra.internal/ff/warm?flag=low-latency-routing`
Deploy-Bot: Rollout progressed to 1% — metrics OK. error-rate 0.02%, p95 1.1s. Next step scheduled in 10m.
Olga: Looks clean from infra side. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Reminder commands if needed: `deploy cancel r-3023456789` or `deploy rollback r-3023456789`.
Deploy-Bot: Rollout paused at 5% due to model-fallback spike = 0.12% (threshold 0.1%). Pausing for manual review.
Maya: Pausing and investigating routing table + model mapping.
Kevin: Agree pause. Revert to 1% until we confirm. @Chris can you validate config?
Chris: Found config drift: `MODEL_OVERRIDE` env var set on canary nodes. Pushing fix to fleet (hot patch).
Deploy-Bot: Patch applied to canary nodes. Re-running gate checks.
Deploy-Bot: Gate checks stable for 5m, resuming rollout: 5% -> 25% after 20m.
Olga: Noted, updating internal deploy log and tagging the change window.
Jess: Added a note in release notes about the temporary pause and fix.
Kevin: Thanks everyone — will close this thread when 25% completes and post final metrics. If anything else, use the deploy commands above.
